requirement: Update an antibiogram in place: reject an unknown or soft-deleted target, unknown or soft-deleted pathogens and antibiotics, and a pathogen + MIC pair owned by another antibiogram, then map the command, reconcile the antibiotic joins, and persist.

preconditions.text: A live antibiogram exists for the target ID
A live pathogen exists for the requested pathogen ID
Every requested antibiotic exists and is not soft-deleted
Another live antibiogram already uses the requested pathogen and MIC pair
A soft-deleted antibiogram already uses the requested pathogen and MIC pair

inputs.text: Update with one antibiotic and MIC Susceptible (lowest enum member)
Update with one antibiotic and MIC Resistant (highest enum member)
Add a second antibiotic to a single-antibiotic panel
Remove one antibiotic from a two-antibiotic panel
Replace the whole panel with two different antibiotics
Two beta-lactams sharing the same group lineage
Update request with an unknown antibiogram ID
Update request with Guid.Empty as the antibiogram ID
Update request for an already soft-deleted antibiogram
Update with an unknown pathogen ID
Update with a soft-deleted pathogen ID
One valid and one unknown antibiotic ID
Pathogen and MIC pair used by another live antibiogram
Same pathogen with a different MIC category
Different pathogen with the same MIC category
Pathogen and MIC pair used only by a soft-deleted antibiogram

returns.text: Success with Updated status; pathogen, MIC category, and timestamp refreshed
The antibiotic join collection matches the requested set
Failure with BadRequest; target antibiogram or pathogen not found
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Not all antibiotic exist' error
Failure with BusinessRuleViolation for a duplicate pathogen and MIC pair

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every failure is returned as a failed Result
